entries.title: French court reduces graft sentence for Marine Le Pen
entries.snippet: Under the appeals verdict, the far-right leader may be able to run for president in 2027, though she would have to wear an ankle monitor. She has previously said she would not stand for election under these conditions.

entries.title: Ukraine: Suspect in Monaco bomb attack found dead near Kyiv

entries.snippet: The German government's draft budget for 2027 includes more money for the military and less for everything else, while debt continues to grow rapidly. The Cabinet has approved it, and now it needs to pass in parliament.
